name: Private dental practices

intake.help: One per line. For example: Implant consultation, £95

Are you a new or existing patient?

Hi {firstName}, a last check in from {businessName}. Reply any time to book.

Hi {firstName}, your consultation at {businessName} is at {bookingTime}.
Hi {firstName}, thank you for visiting {businessName}. If you were happy, a short review would help other patients find us.
Hi {firstName}, it has been six months since your visit to {businessName}. Would you like to book your check up?
